notes.title: June 15, 2024 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Reduced Days to Complete the Game
You can now complete the game in just 24 days instead of the original 48 days. This adjustment allows players to experience the full content of the game more quickly.

2. Fixed Leaderboard Ranking Issue
We have fixed the issue with the leaderboard where players' own rankings were displayed incorrectly. You can now see your correct ranking.

3. Increased Zombie Health and Damage Growth
To make the game more challenging, we have increased the growth rate of zombie health and damage. Previously, most players on the leaderboard, except for me, died only once, indicating the game was too easy.

4. UI Improvements
We've made some minor UI optimizations and added an effect to the leaderboard button to make it more noticeable.

5. Feedback Welcome
We welcome everyone to leave their feedback in the discussion forum or directly in the Steam review section. Your feedback is very important to us, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts and suggestions!

Thank you for your support and feedback. Enjoy the game!
